name: pots/php-befunge
description: A Befunge-93 interpreter library for PHP with injectable input, strict types and no global state.

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan static analysis on src/.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run all quality checks: PHPCS, PHPMD, PHPStan and PHPUnit.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the coding standard (PSR-12) of src/ and tests/.
scripts-descriptions.phpmd: Run the PHP Mess Detector on src/.
